content: 7:1-6 Munon ger wonou qomon me qereiomun
“An munon qei wurinou qomon abari ibag mindigar qob me wurit qamarar. Ende obounon eng Qenu gor anit mindigar qob qemeriba.
An munon qei wurinou qomon qereimunon gas ende Qenu wo gor aninou qomon eng qeemben ende qereimba. Wurinou qomon qerei ne mi mai-mai indarar qamb qomorunon eng Qenu wo gor ende qamara utuboumon.
End ne nonou magqurt nam sau aib net isar eng ten igo ne nonou ima magt mi qanganing wot isar end qamb igoan?
Nonou magqurt nam sau aib net isiner eng ten igama ima mi qanganing wot isiner eng gab, “ima ete aba, mi qanganing magt eng gumotenerimeteibam,” ende qemeriban?
Eng misue, maigas ende me ebinenei. Wo gigit nonou nam sau net isiner eng mom at gumoteneri musub mi gab ne nonou ima mi qanganing eng gumotenerimatat.
Mi qau gab iau me werisar, ende obounon eng wuri igeser anongoarubour. Ne mi uber qenenginob eng bur qib igour werei end bigunon eng wuri napi borusiorubour.”
7:7-12 Qenu qebi qumurune mi uber indariba
Ne bo qamar: “Qebi qamarari andariba, a gub qamb asi qib igamari eng ansirbiga guboumon. Ne qeirtoau bigari igub eng igeser animbegeiba.
Munon gugum qebimari eng werisiba, a gub qamb asi eng gubour, a qeirtoau bigari eng igeser ibegeiba.
Aninou wau ger mani qibit qamara mai, ur der bo nomon utab igo qiyo? Ende ue.
Ne ger, wau der yag wai nib qamb urt qamara eng mai, ur der mi boru ger utab igo qiyo? Ue e.

End ne an munon uber ue eng aninou wau eng sig-sig mom wuri qenungar mi uber wurisab igoumon eng. Eng gas ende aninou Tain an antanamimar eng wonou ginamt igo eng wo munon mi uberet qebi qomorunor eng ar ende werisiba.
Munon qei an anmusiari an wurit mismisir igoumon gas ende gari an gor munon qei ende wurimusiarar. Qomon eng Moses gumater eng nob munon miteri qamb gumatemir eng qamb gumatemir eng ende igo.”
7:13,14 Tend gogorun isau eng
“End ne an tend qomourt end mor isar, tend wauimau end isub eng tap sarog eng toat isub eng munai ginam boru end isub umuboumon. Munon irou tap eng toat isub igour.
Tend qomour ne tap mongomongau boru eng igomot igamau, ginam end isub igo.”
7:15-23 Nam qur big igour eng
“An munon qei qob gigit anmurimar qomorunor eng an imbig igoarar. Wuri wai sipsip goan gas ende at diorubour. Ego wurinou misir erobon eng oau uter eng igoriba.
Wuri qob aninob qamb menman ion abari ibag imbiguboumon. Eng ete gas, wain qor end uyor qur boru ger me imbi igo. Ne ain uben end qiser me di igo.
Nam qaar boru eng qur eng qeemben ende big igo. A nam uber qur nub igoun eng wonou uben end qeemben di igo.
Nam qur uber nub igoun eng bo nam boru uter uben end me dierinerei. Ne nam qur boru uter eng nam qur uber nub igoun end me di igo.
Nam uber nub igoun eng bo qur musub me biga eng suab mutet gumoubour.
End ne munon qob gigit anmurimar qamb eng menman ne qomon eng ion abari ibag wuriimbigar.” (Luk 13.25-27)
“Munon gugum yet, Barai, Barai yet qamb igour eng gugum ende Qenu wonou ginam bibis end me irunorei. Munon gari-gari Qenu wonou mi abar qamb qamara toat ebet igour eng gari irubour.
Qen ger dibenara gab munon irou yet ‘Barai, Barai, ne negab-negab Qenu qob dibes qamb qib igunei. Ne neunumot ai munon igaramor eng wuri musub ne nonou qiribiten eng in ubune gamirei.’
Ende yet qamarari ye ete wurinob qemeribam: ‘Ye an qoyam ue, an munon qomon soagen abau tari. Qand wogub der iuarimar,’ ende qemeribam.”
7:24-29 Munon misir uber ne misir boru nob
“Munon gugum qob eng igub misirt igub toat igorunor eng munon ger qoyam imbi-imbi igo mon nomon erer tumun goanet yab mindater gas ende oboubour.
Mon mindaterei igama ya aib der yaum isuor eng, ne moon sani-sani aib di munai baar eng qoren mom nomon erobon qumo yamor end munai du qamb igoai.
Ego munon gugum qob igub end misir me igub toat ebet igorunor eng munon misir ue mon orosout mindater gas ende.
Mindaterei igama ya aib der yaum yar orosou nerub isa sani-sani aib di mon eng boaburma uburab isorei, mon eng sig borusi uburab isorei.”
Yisas qob eng ende qamb ugea wogub munon yurau aib eng wonou qob uber eng igub borusi qoaguruiamirei.
Wo qob qamara igumir eng qob qiribiten, munon Moses qomon toat qamarari igub igour gas ende ue.
